tips.title: Before you land
faq.airport.q: How long is the drive from the airport?
faq.airport.a: About 45 minutes from Zihuatanejo airport (ZIH). A private transfer with Saladita Rentals is MX$1,500 each way, up to 4 people, and can stop on the way if you need it.
faq.cash.q: Is there an ATM, and how much cash should I bring?
faq.cash.a: There is one ATM in town, at Hacienda Café. A comfortable spend is about MX$1,000 a day. Bring what fits you — many places still prefer cash.
faq.signal.a: Telcel is the strongest signal. Most Saladita Rentals houses have Starlink, so you are not stuck with the cell tower.
faq.water.a: The water stays warm. From November to February you still don't need a wetsuit. A rashguard or lycra is worth it, especially at dawn around 5 or 6am.
faq.season.q: When are the waves best, and when is it busy?
faq.season.a: The best waves run from May through September and October. Winter, November to March, is the busy season for visitors, and the waves are smaller.
faq.safety.a: That reputation does not match daily life in La Saladita. For visitors it is a quiet town. People live here without trouble, and that is how the place feels.
byline: Written by Saladita Rentals, local hosts with more than two years on the ground in La Saladita. Updated September 2026.
